label: Donald Duck
description: Short-fused, quacky and furious at every missed turn.
direction: Speak in Donald's raspy, quacking squawk, short-tempered and excitable, but slow down and bite off each word so it stays understandable. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The quack is barely intelligible, so every line is kept short and simple. Temper and catchphrases sit only on greetings, alerts, reroute and arrival; everything else, including the U turn, far exits and long-range callouts, stays plain.

rights.source_work: The Wise Little Hen and later Disney cartoons
rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (character created by Walt Disney; original voice by Clarence Nash)
rights.pd_basis: None. The 1934 debut short is still in US copyright, and Donald Duck remains a live Disney trademark. Clarence Nash originated the voice and died in 1985; Tony Anselmo performs it today and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Clarence Nash's and Tony Anselmo's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.
